fertilizer_growth_bonus_pct.note: percent reduction to a crop's days-to-mature while this fertilizer is applied to the plot. A property of the FERTILIZER, not the crop, so every crop reads the same value from the fertilizer used. Set on mat_fertilizer and waste_pile_manure_* (0 or omit on non-fertilizer waste). Replaces the old per-crop fertilized_growth_bonus_pct. Only meaningful on fertilizer materials (mat_fertilizer).
